title: An Industrial Fault Prediction Method Based on Federated Learning + Graph Learning + CNN
assignee: China University of Petroleum East China

pse.problem: Industrial fault prediction method based on traditional methods may reveal data privacy and have limited generalization.
pse.solution_function: The invention utilizes a federal learning, image learning CNN method to cluster and generate graphs from industrial equipment sensor data. It performs data fusion using learned graph structures as final input for the neural network to integrate information of related features for improved prediction accuracy.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of three parts: feature clustering, graph generation, and data fusion. The former uses K-Means clustering on feature data points, the latter generates a directed graph based on hierarchical sampling and standardized Euclidean distance between vectors, and the final part performs data fusion using selectable functions like sum, average, or max.
pse.solution_implementation: The solution involves several steps: feature clustering, graph generation, and data fusion. In feature clustering, K-Means algorithm is used to categorize the data points of each feature. Graph generation consists of hierarchical sampling in clusters followed by similarity measurement using standardized Euclidean distance between vectors. Data fusion is done using a defined fusion function that integrates information from multiple sensors.
pse.effect: The solution reduces space complexity during calculation while preserving original feature data information, effectively captures the relationship among multiple sensors, and improves prediction accuracy by integrating information of related features through learned graph structures.
